material: Analytical cell-wall pectin fractions from the thirteen apple cultivars studied by Liu et al.
preparation: Cultivar-specific extracted analytical fractions; not a standardised pectin dose

evidence.statement: The primary composition study isolated and characterised pectin from apple materials.

limitations: Qualitative supply only; retain cultivar, fraction and food-matrix variation. No per-100-g pectin amount inferred from total fibre; whole fruit is not purified citrus pectin.

material: Chicory root material used for inulin extraction and chemical characterisation
preparation: Extracted/purified analytical inulin; whole-root and roasted preparations are not interchangeable

evidence.statement: Chicory-root extraction with chemical characterisation supports inulin presence.

limitations: Extraction yield/purity is not edible-food inulin concentration. This prospective source does not add an admitted PM5 input.
